translations.english: Indrajith pierced Rama with arrows coated with gold and gold tipped arrows, which had even and circular heads, with halfmoon arrows, with axe like heads, heads like joined palms, heads resembling teeth of calf and lion teeth arrows as well as razor sharp arrows which descended quickly unobstructed like dust.
translations.hindi: समस्त दिशाओं ओर विदिशाओ ;की साफ कर दिआ। श्रीराम नांमाङ्कित बाणो' से वहाँ का रणक्षेत्र व्याप्त हो गया
